bio: Bishopstrow House is a beautiful ivy-clad Georgian country house dating from 1815 set in the Wylye Valley between Bath and Salisbury. The interiors are elegantly decorated with fine paintings, antiques and fresh flowers. The gardens have a private frontage to the river and are home to a magnificent rotunda temple, dating from 1770, and a Palladian style summerhouse.  The perfect place to enjoy afternoon tea for two, 18th Century Bishopstrow House Hotel in Wiltshire is a temple to relaxation. This elegant four star hotel is set in stunning Wylye Valley countryside and boasts its own stretch of rippling river. Treat yourself to a mouth-watering Bishopstrow House afternoon tea for two.
